counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The best-effort summary baseline silently omits the old restriction. The ABI exposes the frontier and returns a mandatory-field fault for release use.
readable_claim: A context summary may be faithful enough for one consumer and still be unsafe for another because omissions, authority, freshness, purpose, and adequacy are part of the interface.
normative_rule: Resolve stable object and snapshot references into a packet whose certificate names exact sources, fields, transformations, omissions, loss, taint, authority, rights, uses, freshness, lease, selection frontier, adequacy state, cost, faults, and residuals. Missing mandatory context returns a typed fault, never best-effort silence.
